photos.title: Oriental Magpie Robin at Sunset
photos.story: An oriental magpie robin sings its last notes, framed against a burning sun.

Big Cats of Gir.caption: The last refuge of the Asiatic lion and the elusive leopard — Gir's great predators, watched with patience and quiet respect.

Raptors & Owls.caption: Eyes of the forest. The hunters that rule Gujarat's open skies and its shadowed, tangled canopies.

Wetlands of Junagadh.caption: Where water meets the city — flamingos, kingfishers and waders that turn Junagadh's wetlands into a living theatre.

Songbirds of Gujarat.caption: The smaller voices of the wild — larks, pittas and flycatchers, each a splash of colour in the scrub and forest edge.

After Dark.caption: When the forest sleeps, the sky wakes. Long nights spent under some of Gujarat's darkest, star-flooded skies.

Reptiles.caption: The cold-blooded and the misunderstood — snakes, lizards and the reptiles that keep the ecosystem in balance.
